title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PER SHITJE TEK AURA RESIDENCE!
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e peste te nje prej komplekseve me te reja dhe cilesore te Tiranes, tek Aura Residence, ne Rrugen Dritan Hoxha, ne Laprake.
Kompleksi sapo ka perfunduar dhe eshte ne fazen e vendosjes se rifiniturave perfundimtare.
Apartamenti ka nje planimetri te rregullt dhe eshte i organizuar ne:
Dy koridore te vogla qe bejne shperndarjen
Nje sallon se bashku me kuzhinen
Nje ballkon i aksesueshem nga salloni
Dy dhoma gjumi, njera prej te cilave me tualet te brendshem
Dy tualete ne total
Orientimi shume i favorshem jug-lindje dhe veri-perendim ben qe apartamenti te jete i ndricuar ne menyre natyrale gjate gjithe dites
Prona disponon kontrate blerje te rregullt te regjistruar ne institucionet perkatese dhe pritet qe brenda vitit 2025 te pajiset me certifikate pronesie
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE AT AURA RESIDENCE!
description_en: The apartment is located on the fifth floor of one of the newest and quality complexes in Tirana, at Aura Residence, on Dritan Hoxha Street, in Laprake. The complex has just been completed and is in the phase of placing the final finishes. The apartment has a regular floor plan and is organized in: Two small corridors that make the distribution A living room together with the kitchen A balcony accessible from the living room Two bedrooms, one of which with an internal toilet Two toilets in total The very favorable orientation south-east and north-west means that the apartment is lit naturally throughout the day The property has regular purchase contracts registered with the relevant institutions and it is expected that within the year 2025 to be equipped with ownership certificates
